seo.meta_title: The Amalfi Llama: Locations, Hours and What It Is
seo.meta_description: The Amalfi Llama is a live-fire Italian and Patagonian restaurant with locations in Aventura, Florida, and San Diego's UTC. Addresses and what to expect.

question: Where Is The Amalfi Llama?
quick_answer: The Amalfi Llama has two locations. The first opened in early 2024 at Esplanade at Aventura, 19505 Biscayne Blvd. in Aventura, Florida, next to Aventura Mall. The second opened in March 2024 at The Collection at UTC, 4575 La Jolla Village Drive in San Diego. Both serve the same mix of live-fire Patagonian-style grilling and Italian food, from wood-fire pizza and handmade pasta to steaks and chops.

body.heading: What The Amalfi Llama is
body.text: The Amalfi Llama blends two styles: the live-fire grilling of Patagonia, in South America, and the food of Italy's Mediterranean coast. A big wood-fire grill is the centerpiece, and the menu runs from focaccia and wood-fire pizzas to handmade pasta, prime steaks, chops and seafood. The wine list leans on Argentina, Italy and the United States. The llama in the name shows up in the decor, including Peruvian llama tassels.

body.heading: Who owns it
body.text: The Amalfi Llama comes from a partnership between California's Eureka! Restaurant Group and Mexico City's Grupo Carolo Hospitality. Eduardo Gomez is CEO of both groups. Together they run more than 50 restaurants in the U.S. and Mexico City.

body.heading: Aventura, Florida
body.text: The first Amalfi Llama opened at Esplanade at Aventura, an open-air shopping and dining center beside Aventura Mall, at 19505 Biscayne Blvd. It was planned for December 2023 and was reported open by late January 2024. The space is about 9,600 square feet, with bars, a private dining room and covered outdoor seating. The phone number is (305) 726-0226.

body.heading: San Diego
body.text: The second location opened on March 25, 2024, at The Collection at UTC, 4575 La Jolla Village Drive in San Diego's University City area. Its opening hours were listed as 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. Sunday through Wednesday and 11 a.m. to midnight Thursday through Saturday. Hours can change, so check before you go.

body.heading: Prices
body.text: The Amalfi Llama is upscale. On our latest check, pastas run about $26 to $60, wood-fire pizzas $24 to $31 and steaks and chops $49 to $82. See our Amalfi Llama menu for the full list.
